body.label: Effect
body.html: Establish a 2-unit Circle centered on a point within 4 units. Enemies treat it as difficult terrain until your next turn.

surges.html: Once before this Rite ends, you may change one named target of the Rite to another eligible target.
Increase this Rite's Echo Limit by 1; when its final Echo resolves, one ally in range becomes Rallied.

rider.title: CIRCLE RITE
rider.html: After resolving this Action, you may establish this Rite. Trigger: A creature crosses the Circle's boundary. Echo: Move that creature 1 unit toward or away from the Circle's center.
